Video Alpha.gates: Proj Enable on, Proj Intensity > 0, Proj Alpha > 0, Proj Beam > 0 or Proj Surface > 0 (without a picture the projector is a white light); Proj Source File (Wow FX; Wow is always File) with a VIDEO file (mov/mp4/m4v) that opens; a video WITH alpha and alpha < 1 somewhere

Video Loop.effect: Scrub freezes on Video Position; the others differ after the end.
Video Loop.gates: Proj Enable on, Proj Intensity > 0, Proj Alpha > 0, Proj Beam > 0 or Proj Surface > 0 (without a picture the projector is a white light); Proj Source File (Wow FX; Wow is always File) with a VIDEO file (mov/mp4/m4v) that opens; differences show at the clip's end (Loop / Ping-Pong / Once) or at once for Scrub (3, DXV / HAP only)

Video Position.gates: Proj Enable on, Proj Intensity > 0, Proj Alpha > 0, Proj Beam > 0 or Proj Surface > 0 (without a picture the projector is a white light); Proj Source File (Wow FX; Wow is always File) with a VIDEO file (mov/mp4/m4v) that opens; Scrub: the frame; other modes: a user change cues

Video Restart.effect: Jumps the video back to the first frame.
Video Restart.gates: Proj Enable on, Proj Intensity > 0, Proj Alpha > 0, Proj Beam > 0 or Proj Surface > 0 (without a picture the projector is a white light); Proj Source File (Wow FX; Wow is always File) with a VIDEO file (mov/mp4/m4v) that opens; the video must have played past frame 0 first

Video Speed.gates: Proj Enable on, Proj Intensity > 0, Proj Alpha > 0, Proj Beam > 0 or Proj Surface > 0 (without a picture the projector is a white light); Proj Source File (Wow FX; Wow is always File) with a VIDEO file (mov/mp4/m4v) that opens

Video Time.effect: Read-only display text; no pixel effect.
Video Time.suspect: By design never reaches pixels: SetTextId only echoes it back (LoadEhrPlugin.cpp:418), the plugin writes it (LoadEhrPlugin.cpp:3428)

Voxel.effect: Vertices snap to a 3D grid: blocky model.
